sample_data_caveats: Alpaca IEX minute bars are research-only and are not consolidated SIP/full-market evidence.
The untouched lockbox contains 102 trading sessions, below the 252-day forensics threshold.
The selected candidate trails naive momentum and TQQQ buy-and-hold on the lockbox despite passing the pre-registered gate.
capacity_assessment: Personal-size research only. TQQQ next-open execution requires spread, gap, ADV participation, and fill-quality review before paper use.
notes: Nine fixed candidates were selected using development and validation only. The final lockbox was opened once for one candidate. Features use bar-close data and exposure begins at the next bar open. Continue means further frozen-parameter research only, not promotion, ML, or paper readiness.
